+                     200 * (f[..., 1] - f[..., 2])], -1)
+

+def stroke_footprint(stroke):
+    pts = np.asarray(stroke["points"], np.float64)
+    vs = np.rint((.0135925 - pts[:, 0]) * 1000 / PIX_MM - .5).astype(int)
+    us = np.rint((.1135925 - pts[:, 1]) * 1000 / PIX_MM - .5).astype(int)
+    r = (.50 + (.0185 - pts[:, 2]) * 320) / PIX_MM
+    ymin = max(0, min(vs) - 9); ymax = min(1024, max(vs) + 10)
+    xmin = max(0, min(us) - 9); xmax = min(1024, max(us) + 10)
+    mask = np.zeros((ymax - ymin, xmax - xmin), bool)
+    for i in range(len(pts)):
+        a = max(0, i - 1)
+        steps = max(1, int(np.hypot(vs[i] - vs[a], us[i] - us[a]) / 1.5))
+        for j in range(steps + 1):
+            f = j / steps
+            v = int(round(vs[a] * (1 - f) + vs[i] * f))
+            u = int(round(us[a] * (1 - f) + us[i] * f))
+            rad = max(1.5, r[a] * (1 - f) + r[i] * f)
+            rp = int(np.ceil(rad))
